name: super-copy-paste
title: Super Copy/Paste - Apply Regex Rules to Clean Copied Text
description: Allows to perform Regex Cleanup before copying or pasting
author: juan_manuel_ganancias

commands.name: super-copy-1
commands.title: Super Copy 1
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 1) on selected text and copies to Clipboard

commands.name: super-copy-2
commands.title: Super Copy 2
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 2) on selected text and copies to Clipboard

commands.name: super-copy-3
commands.title: Super Copy 3
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 3) on selected text and copies to Clipboard

commands.name: super-paste-1
commands.title: Super Paste 1
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 1) on Clipboard text and pastes the result

commands.name: super-paste-2
commands.title: Super Paste 2
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 2) on Clipboard text and pastes the result

commands.name: super-paste-3
commands.title: Super Paste 3
commands.description: Performs Regex cleanups (Profile 3) on Clipboard text and pastes the result

commands.name: manage-rules
commands.title: Manage Rules
commands.description: Create and edit Regex rules for the Super Copy and Super Paste commands

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
